selection: first CH1 rising edge to recording end; remove CH2 High plus 0.3ms tail and invalid CH4; concatenate retained indices
window: Hann, symmetric, applied only after full distance FFT segmentation
auxiliary_path_interpretation: user requested 100m used as physical travel-path difference; coil one-way length vs OPD pending clarification
masked_auxiliary_infinity_policy: Permit CH3 infinity only if already removed by the unchanged CH2/CH4 exclusion mask. Never interpolate or retain a nonfinite auxiliary sample. The current C# raw reader rejects CH3 infinity before masking; record this input compatibility difference.
k_resampling: UI-equivalent two-stage linear interpolation using record-high phase anchors, separate CH3 per sweep, common relative phase span
correlation: circular normalized cross-correlation of mean-removed local-spectrum magnitudes; real positive maximum; 3-point fractional peak
golden_policy: No production processing changes. Independent native FFT, known spectral translation, same-input zero, known range tone, real reverse-pair controls. Legacy 5.5-6.5m plateau is not ground truth for this thermal acquisition.
